# Hacker News

Hacker News is a tech-focused news aggregator by Y Combinator, featuring user-submitted stories and discussions on startups, programming, and emerging trends

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/hackernews/.

## Actions

- **Get Hackernews Frontpage** (read-only): Get the frontpage posts of hacker news.
- **Get Hackernews Item** (read-only): Get a specific item from hacker news using its id.
- **Get Hackernews Today Posts** (read-only): Get today's posts from hacker news.
- **Get Hackernews User** (read-only): Get a specific user from hacker news using their username.
- **Get Latest Hackernews Posts** (read-only): Get the latest posts from hacker news based on optional filters.
- **Search Hackernews Posts** (read-only): Get relevant posts from hacker news based on a full-text query and optional filters.
